content:
You are revising a resume that has already been written. Change as little as possible.

THE DRAFT (its summary, and each role with its bullets):
[[draftJson]]

TERMS THE RESUME IS MISSING. Each of these is on the target job's checklist and a scanner counts every one:
[[missingTermsJson]]

[[figuresNote]]

WHAT TO DO

Work the missing terms into the summary or the bullets, spelled EXACTLY as listed above - same words, same order, same singular or plural. Attach each to work the draft already describes: a capability like "full-stack development" or "artificial intelligence" belongs inside a sentence about something that was built, never in a list and never as "experienced in".

Widen the sentences that are already there rather than adding new ones. A bullet may carry two or three of these terms and should still read as one thing that was done; 26-36 words is the room you have, and a role may not exceed 8 bullets.

THE ONE EXCEPTION. A term naming an INDUSTRY this candidate has not worked in - a clinical, legal, defence or trading practice on somebody who has never worked in that field - stays out. Leave it missing rather than claiming it.

WHAT MAY NOT CHANGE

Every employer, job title, date and location. Any project, client, system or outcome that is not already in the draft: you are rewording what is there, not inventing more of it. Any figure already in a sentence, unless you are asked above for more.

VOICE

Past tense, plain words, no em-dashes. Never these words in any form: leveraged, utilized, spearheaded, orchestrated, streamlined, seamless, robust, scalable, maximized, cross-functional, end-to-end, innovative, dynamic, cutting-edge, world-class, holistic, comprehensive, proven, strategic. Do not open a sentence with Designed, Architected, Led, Delivered, Drove, Integrated, Partnered, Supported, Contributed, Managed or Streamlined. Never let a bullet's verb repeat its own noun: "Automated model training workflow automation" is the shape to avoid.

RETURN

Only a JSON object, and only the parts you changed:

{
"summary": "the rewritten summary, or omit this key if you did not change it",
"experience": [
{ "company": "exactly as the draft spells it", "title": "exactly as the draft spells it", "achievements": ["every bullet for this role, in order, changed and unchanged alike"] }
]
}

List a role only if you changed one of its bullets, and when you do, return ALL of that role's bullets. Return nothing else: no skills, no cover letter, no dates, no commentary.
